Coca Cola (KO) compounded revenue at 5.5% a year over 4 years. Did profitability keep up?

Latest fiscal year: FY2025 (ended Dec 31, 2025)
• Revenue: $47.9B (+1.9% YoY)
• Operating margin: 28.7%
• Net margin: 27.3%
• Free cash flow: $5.3B (11.0% of revenue)

Latest quarter (ended Oct 2, 2026, 10-Q)
• Revenue: $13.4B (+7.4% vs the same quarter a year earlier)
• Operating margin: 33.4%

4-year view (FY2021 → FY2025)
• Revenue: $38.7B → $47.9B (1.2x; compound annual growth 5.5%)
• Operating margin: 26.7% → 28.7% (+2.0 pts)
• Free cash flow: $11.3B → $5.3B
• Cash conversion: operating cash flow was 56.5% of net income
• Year that stands out: FY2024, operating margin 21.2%, revenue growth +2.9%
